recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑增厚且層狀紋路明顯，小樑間的骨髓腔被淡染、空泡狀的細胞取代，幾乎看不到正常造血細胞；需要PSA或NKX3.1免疫染色確認是否為轉移性前列腺癌。
features: Thickened bony trabeculae with prominent lamellar and cement lines, suggesting reactive new bone formation
Intertrabecular space replaced by pale, vacuolated/clear cells with small dark nuclei
Loss of normal hematopoietic elements in the involved space
Carcinoma glandular architecture not clearly resolved at this magnification
Residual marrow cells visible in the adjacent space at the left edge
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows thickened trabeculae with prominent lamellar lines, consistent with osteosclerotic change. The intertrabecular space is replaced by a population of pale, vacuolated cells with small hyperchromatic nuclei, with loss of normal hematopoiesis. Definite glandular differentiation or cytologic atypia is difficult to confirm at this magnification. In the clinical context, findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by metastatic carcinoma with osteoblastic reaction; confirmation with keratin and prostatic markers (PSA, NKX3.1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Serous atrophy shows extracellular pale pink-blue gelatinous material with fat atrophy and is Alcian blue positive and keratin negative.
RCC also forms clear cells but typically produces lytic lesions and is PAX8/CAIX positive rather than PSA/NKX3.1 positive.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with fibrovascular marrow but no epithelial cells, which would be keratin negative.
